messages:
elaine-sales: heads up — Acme's risk team (SIG) emailed asking for BCP/DR specifics + a short sandbox failover demo for their vendor review. They need: RTO/RPO numbers, backup cadence & retention, encryption + KMS, recent restore test evidence, and a 20-30min demo slot. Can ops/security do this next week? :wave:

sam-eng: we can run a non-prod failover from staging -> staging-west. Target RTO ~15m, RPO 1h for model assets. Backups: snapshots every 4h, daily full exports to S3 (encrypted with CMK). Retention: 30 days snapshots, 90 days export. Will need to stub any external callbacks in the demo.

jaime-security: for SIG/CAIQ they also expect control references: data-at-rest encryption, KMS key rotation, backup immutability, recovery metrics, and evidence of a successful restore. Can you share the test report + the signed runbook page?

oliver-cs: I have the Nov 2025 DR test PDF and the runbook excerpt. Link: https://redwood-internal/rdocs/dr-tests/2025-11-dr-test.pdf — contains restore logs, timelines, and postmortem. Note: that test used Dedicated capacity; hosted behavior is slightly different (we'll call that out).

sam-eng: important: model state/dump details — during failover we snapshot model weights + KV cache dump. Ops runbook snippet:
```
# failover snippet
./run-failover --from=staging --to=staging-west --preserve-kvcache
sleep 30
./verify-traffic --endpoint /_health
```
We'll run a dry-run first, then the live demo.

elaine-sales: ok thanks. Can we offer these demo windows? Tue 2026-04-05 16:00 UTC or Thu 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC. Which works for engineering & security?

jaime-security: Thu 09:00 UTC works. Also pls prepare a one-page mapping table tying SIG questions to controls (e.g. RTO -> "Recover to serving <=15m via cross-region autoswap; see runbook §3"). I can polish it for the vendor pack.

oliver-cs: I'll prep the table and redact any customer names in the PDF. I'll also extract the restore timeline into CSV for the SIG reviewers.

deploy-bot: booking created: demo-1939975310 — Thu 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC — staging-west reserved for 1h. :white_check_mark:

elaine-sales: perfect — I'll confirm Thu with Acme and attach the runbook excerpt + the one-page control mapping. Thanks everyone! :tada:
